channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Inflation persisted in August, potentially locking in a Fed interest rate hike
item.description: The all-items consumer price index was expected to rise 0.4% in August, with core, excluding food and energy, showing a 0.2% gain, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

item.title: Analysis: Hot CPI puts Kevin Warsh’s Fed credibility on the line before rate decision
item.description: August CPI data leave Kevin Warsh to choose between acting on his inflation warnings or risking new doubts about his control of the central bank.

item.title: Houthis reportedly advance to key Red Sea island, further threatening crucial oil choke point
item.description: The advance raises the threat to shipping near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a waterway that connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden to global markets.

item.title: 25 years after 9/11, the U.S. starts rolling back travel restrictions, from liquids to gate access
item.description: Years after 9/11, the U.S. government is walking back some security screenings as threats and technology evolve.

item.title: UAE plans $46 billion investment in Germany, with data centers a key focus
item.description: The UAE plans to invest 40 billion euros ($46.4 billion) in Germany, with data center infrastructure a key part of the package.

item.title: Europe is still waiting for a trillion-dollar company. Here’s PitchBook’s frontrunner
item.description: "With average growth assumptions, Europe should see a significant number of trillion-dollar public companies emerge by the late 2030s," the analysis firm said.

item.title: Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness is active in options market, sources say
item.description: Situational Awareness has been buying options positions in stocks including Advanced Micro Devices, Bloom Energy and Coreweave, sources told CNBC's David Faber.

item.title: AI regulation calls grow in D.C. after researcher's extinction warning
item.description: Members of Congress are calling for AI regulation after a researcher warned that OpenAI and Anthropic are acting irresponsibly.

item.title: Bessent says 'a large bank' will be sanctioned on Monday as part of Iran strategy
item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said a large bank would be sanctioned next week.

item.title: Oil prices fall sharply after double-digit weekly gains above $100
item.description: The decline snapped multi-day winning streaks for both Brent and WTI crude oil futures.

item.title: Wealthy investors are pouring billions into this new tax strategy despite risks
item.description: Total assets invested in so-called tax-aware long-short strategies — or TALS — have surged to more than $170 billion, according to Tax Alpha Insider.

item.title: Sub-$100 smartphones becoming a rarity as AI memory prices soar
item.description: The days of the sub-$100 smartphone may be numbered, including in China.

item.title: Trump dismisses AI extinction risks as more than a dozen OpenAI, Anthropic insiders call for a slowdown
item.description: Trump said he isn't concerned AI could cause human extinction as researchers at leading AI companies warn about rapid advances and lawmakers propose safeguards.

item.title: U.S. diesel price tops $6 per gallon, a record high as Ukraine and Iran wars ripple through economy
item.description: U.S. diesel prices hit their highest level ever as fuel supply disruption stemming from the Ukraine and Iran wars lifts transportation costs.

item.title: Hassett kept up to $5 million Coinbase stake as Trump reshaped crypto policy
item.description: Trump economic advisor Kevin Hassett owned as much as $5 million in Coinbase while serving as the White House's top economic advisor, his disclosure shows.

item.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Friday
item.description: Stocks are still looking at a higher open after consumer inflation, excluding food and energy prices, came in hotter than expected.

item.title: Trump says he has no regrets about starting the Iran war as U.S. dials up economic pressure
item.description: Speaking to Fox News presenter Laura Ingraham, Trump said that he would have attacked Iran despite the impact on the midterm elections.

item.title: $6 diesel should benefit Tesla's trucking ambitions, Morgan Stanley says
item.description: "$6 Diesel...Enter Tesla Semi," the investment bank's Andrew Percoco told clients in a Friday note.

item.title: Elon Musk's Boring Co. turns to Middle East for expansion in reaching $23 billion valuation
item.description: The Boring Co.'s latest $3 billion financing round was led by the United Arab Emirates.

item.title: Why fears of AI self-improvement are causing ‘existential’ concerns at Anthropic and OpenAI
item.description: AI researchers are warning that faster AI self-improvement could eventually make advanced systems harder for humans to control.

item.title: Oracle's stock rises on earnings and revenue beat fueled by AI cloud demand
item.description: Oracle's cloud infrastructure revenue jumped 121% from a year earlier, reflecting demand for AI cloud services.

item.title: Ending soon: These two Chase Ink Business card bonuses are worth $1,000. Should you apply?
item.description: Two of Chase’s primary business cards currently offer a bonus of $1,000, but it’s ending soon.

item.title: Chinese AI labs secretly used millions of Claude exchanges to train their models, Anthropic says
item.description: Anthropic said it detected unauthorized efforts by China-based AI labs including Alibaba and Moonshot AI to use its Claude models to help improve their own AI systems.

item.title: The oil shock is testing private credit borrowers already burdened by high debt costs
item.description: Oil near $100 could further squeeze leveraged private credit borrowers as investors weigh the risk that inflation could push interest rates higher again.

item.title: Nonprofit received $2 million from Olivia Rodrigo and Melinda French Gates—it wants to give cash to abuse survivors
item.description: The money nonprofit Freefrom received from participating in Olivia Rodrigo's Daisy Chain Music Festival helped the organization hit its annual finacial goal.

item.title: IEA warns global oil refining system ‘stretched to the limit’ as Iran, Ukraine wars tighten market
item.description: The energy agency warned shrinking inventories and strained refineries could further tighten markets.

item.title: Micron's Taiwan workers to get rewards worth up to 68 months of pay
item.description: Micron said the payouts to employees were its strongest ever and that more than 60,000 staff globally will receive fiscal 2026 rewards.

item.title: China-Philippines tensions simmer after Beijing rebukes Manila over Seoul clash
item.description: China and the Philippines have been locked in years of tension over their competing claims in the South China Sea, with friction intensifying in recent months.

item.title: Jamie Dimon joins bankers lobbying the UK ahead of its critical budget — here’s why they’re worried
item.description: Bankers are pressuring the British government ahead of its Autumn Budget, in which the newly minted leadership will lay out its fiscal plans for Britain.

item.title: Jim Cramer says this is the key force driving stocks right now
item.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said the 30-year Treasury yield is a key force driving stocks as it climbs to roughly 5.3%.
